// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface ISRG {
    function getBNBPrice() external view returns (uint256);
    function calculatePrice() external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
}

contract BANKofBANKS {
    string public constant name = "BANK of BANKS";
    string public constant symbol = "SRG";
    uint8 public constant decimals = 9;

    uint256 private constant DIVISOR = 10000;
    uint256 private constant SHAREDIVISOR = 100;
    uint256 private constant PADDING = 1e18;

    address public owner;
    uint256 private _status;
    uint256 private _tradingOpen;

    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isTxLimitExempt;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isFeeExempt;

    uint256 public sellMul;
    uint256 public buyMul;
    uint256 public maxBag;
    uint256 public taxBalance;

    address public treasuryWallet;
    address public teamWallet;
    uint256 public treasuryShare;
    uint256 public teamShare;
    uint256 public liqConst;
    uint256 public totalLiquidity;

    uint256 private _tradingEnabled;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public volume;
    uint256 public totalVolume;
    uint256 public totalTx;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public txTimeStamp;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256[5]) private _candleStickData;

    ISRG private constant SRG = ISRG(0xcd682ef09d07668d49a8103ddd65ff54aebfbfde);

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
    event Bought(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, uint256 amountOut, uint256 timestamp);
    event Sold(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, uint256 amountOut, uint256 timestamp);
    event MaxBagChanged(uint256 newMaxBag);
    event FeesMulChanged(uint256 newSellMul, uint256 newBuyMul);

    error Panic(uint256 errorCode);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_status == 2, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _status = 2;
        _;
        _status = 1;
    }

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        _status = 2;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return liqConst * totalLiquidity / PADDING;
    }

    function _totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return liqConst * totalLiquidity / PADDING;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function _balances(address) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[msg.sender];
    }

    function allowance(address owner_, address spender) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _allowances[owner_][spender];
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function _approve(address owner_, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(owner_ != address(0), "SRG20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "SRG20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowances[owner_][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner_, spender, amount);
    }

    function approveMax(address spender) public returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, type(uint256).max);
        return true;
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        _transfer(msg.sender, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        _spendAllowance(from, msg.sender, amount);
        _transfer(from, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function _spendAllowance(address owner_, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[owner_][spender];
        if (currentAllowance != type(uint256).max) {
            require(currentAllowance >= amount, "SRG20: insufficient allowance");
            _approve(owner_, spender, currentAllowance - amount);
        }
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");

        uint256 fromBalance = _balances[from];
        require(fromBalance >= amount, "SRG20: insufficient allowance");

        _balances[from] = fromBalance - amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;

        emit Approval(from, to, amount);
    }

    function getLiquidity() public view returns (uint256) {
        return liqConst;
    }

    function liquidity() public view returns (uint256) {
        return liqConst;
    }

    function liqConst() public view returns (uint256) {
        return totalLiquidity;
    }

    function teamShare() public view returns (uint256) {
        return treasuryShare;
    }

    function treasuryShare() public view returns (uint256) {
        return teamShare;
    }

    function isFeeExempt(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isFeeExempt[account];
    }

    function isTxLimitExempt(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isTxLimitExempt[account];
    }

    function tradeOpen() public view returns (bool) {
        return _tradingOpen == 1;
    }

    function getCirculatingSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return totalSupply();
    }

    function getMarketCap() public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 srgPrice = getSRGPrice();
        return totalSupply() * srgPrice / PADDING;
    }

    function getValueOfHoldings(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 srgPrice = getSRGPrice();
        return _balances[account] * srgPrice / PADDING;
    }

    function getTokenAmountOut(uint256 amount) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 srgPrice = getSRGPrice();
        return amount * PADDING / srgPrice;
    }

    function getsrgAmountOut(uint256 amount) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 srgPrice = getSRGPrice();
        return amount * srgPrice / PADDING;
    }

    function candleStickData(uint256 timestamp) public view returns (uint256 open, uint256 high, uint256 low, uint256 close, uint256 vol) {
        uint256[5] memory data = _candleStickData[timestamp];
        return (data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4]);
    }

    function txTimeStamp(uint256 txIndex) public view returns (uint256) {
        return txTimeStamp[txIndex];
    }

    function tVol(uint256 timestamp) public view returns (uint256) {
        return volume[timestamp];
    }

    function DIVISOR() public pure returns (uint256) {
        return 10000;
    }

    function SHAREDIVISOR() public pure returns (uint256) {
        return 100;
    }

    function PADDING() public pure returns (uint256) {
        return 1e18;
    }

    function getSRGPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        return SRG.calculatePrice();
    }

    function getBNBPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        return SRG.getBNBPrice();
    }

    function calculatePrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        return SRG.calculatePrice();
    }

    function openTrading() public onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require((_tradingEnabled & 1) == 0, "You cannot disable trading after enabling!");
        _tradingEnabled |= 1;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        address oldOwner = owner;
        owner = address(0);
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, address(0));
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        address oldOwner = owner;
        owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function changeWalletLimit(uint256 newMaxBag) public onlyOwner {
        require(newMaxBag >= totalSupply() / 100, "New wallet limit should be at least 1% of total supply");
        maxBag = newMaxBag;
        emit MaxBagChanged(newMaxBag);
    }

    function changeFees(uint256 newSellMul, uint256 newBuyMul) public onlyOwner {
        sellMul = newSellMul;
        buyMul = newBuyMul;
        emit FeesMulChanged(newSellMul, newBuyMul);
    }

    function changeFeeReceivers(address newTreasuryWallet, address newTeamWallet) public onlyOwner {
        require(newTreasuryWallet != address(0) && newTeamWallet != address(0), "New wallets must not be the ZERO address");
        treasuryWallet = newTreasuryWallet;
        teamWallet = newTeamWallet;
    }

    function changeTaxDistribution(uint256 newTreasuryShare, uint256 newTeamShare) public onlyOwner {
        require(newTreasuryShare + newTeamShare == SHAREDIVISOR, "Sum of shares must be SHAREDIVISOR");
        treasuryShare = newTreasuryShare;
        teamShare = newTeamShare;
    }

    function changeIsFeeExempt(address account, bool exempt) public onlyOwner {
        _isFeeExempt[account] = exempt;
    }

    function changeIsTxLimitExempt(address account, bool exempt) public onlyOwner {
        _isTxLimitExempt[account] = exempt;
    }

    function withdrawTaxBalance() public onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        _status = 1;
        taxBalance = 0;
    }

    function addLiquidity(uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        require(totalLiquidity > 0, "No Liquidity");
        totalLiquidity += amount;
    }

    function _buy(uint256 amount, uint256 deadline, uint256 minOut) public nonReentrant {
        require(_tradingOpen == 1 || block.timestamp < deadline, "Deadline EXPIRED or trade is not open!");
        require(!_isTxLimitExempt[msg.sender] || _balances[msg.sender] + amount <= maxBag, "Max wallet!");

        uint256 srgPrice = getSRGPrice();
        uint256 amountOut = amount * PADDING / srgPrice;
        require(amountOut >= minOut, "INSUFFICIENT OUTPUT AMOUNT");

        require(SRG.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount), "transfer of SRG failed!");

        _balances[msg.sender] += amountOut;
        totalLiquidity += amount;

        _updateVolumeAndTx(amountOut);

        emit Bought(msg.sender, address(this), amount, amountOut, block.timestamp);
        _status = 1;
    }

    function _sell(uint256 amount, uint256 deadline, uint256 minOut) public nonReentrant {
        require(_tradingOpen == 1 || block.timestamp < deadline, "Deadline EXPIRED or trade is not open!");

        uint256 srgPrice = getSRGPrice();
        uint256 amountOut = amount * srgPrice / PADDING;
        require(amountOut >= minOut, "INSUFFICIENT OUTPUT AMOUNT");

        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= amount, "INSUFFICIENT OUTPUT AMOUNT");

        _balances[msg.sender] -= amount;
        totalLiquidity -= amountOut;

        require(SRG.transfer(msg.sender, amountOut), "transfer of SRG failed!");

        _updateVolumeAndTx(amount);

        emit Sold(msg.sender, address(this), amount, amountOut, block.timestamp);
        _status = 1;
    }

    function _updateVolumeAndTx(uint256 amount) internal {
        volume[block.timestamp] += amount;
        totalVolume += amount;
        totalTx++;
        txTimeStamp[totalTx] = block.timestamp;

        uint256[5] storage candle = _candleStickData[block.timestamp];
        if (candle[0] == 0) {
            candle[0] = getSRGPrice();
            candle[1] = candle[0];
            candle[2] = candle[0];
            candle[3] = candle[0];
        }
        uint256 currentPrice = getSRGPrice();
        if (currentPrice > candle[1]) candle[1] = currentPrice;
        if (currentPrice < candle[2] || candle[2] == 0) candle[2] = currentPrice;
        candle[3] = currentPrice;
        candle[4] += amount;
    }
}

    error WinnerAlreadySet();
    error WinnerNotSet();

    error NotAValidTeamIdentifier();

        _;
    }

    }

        return _resolver;
    }

        return _totalBetPool;
    }

        return _gameCount;
    }

    function setResolver(address newResolver) external onlyOwner {
        _resolver = newResolver;
    }

        return uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(gameId))) + offset;
    }

        betAmounts = new uint256[](resultCount);
        teams = new uint256[](resultCount);

                team1Meta: _readString(baseSlot + 3),
                team2Meta: _readString(baseSlot + 4),
                pool: _readUint(baseSlot + 5),
                packedData2: _readUint(baseSlot + 6),
                teamBets: _readBytes(baseSlot + 7),
                winner: address(uint160(_readUint(baseSlot + 8))),
                data9: _readUint(baseSlot + 9),
                data10: _readUint(baseSlot + 10),
                data11: _readUint(baseSlot + 11),
                validity: _readUint(baseSlot + 12),
                endTime: _readUint(baseSlot + 13),
                data14: _readUint(baseSlot + 14),
                winnerSet: _readUint(baseSlot + 15),
                data16: _readUint(baseSlot + 16),
                invalidated: _readUint(baseSlot + 17),
                rewardEndTime: _readUint(baseSlot + 18)
            });
        }
        return games;
    }

    function getGamesPool(uint256[] calldata gameIds) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256[] memory pools = new uint256[](gameIds.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < gameIds.length; i++) {
            pools[i] = _readUint(_getGameSlot(gameIds[i], 5));
        }
        return pools;
    }

    function getGamesMeta(uint256[] calldata gameIds) external view returns (
        string[] memory team1Metas,
        string[] memory team2Metas
    ) {
        team1Metas = new string[](gameIds.length);
        team2Metas = new string[](gameIds.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < gameIds.length; i++) {
            uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameIds[i], 0);
            team1Metas[i] = _readString(baseSlot + 3);
            team2Metas[i] = _readString(baseSlot + 4);
        }
    }

    function getGameResolverData(uint256 gameId) external view returns (
        address gameWinner,
        uint256 endTime,
        uint256 winnerSetFlag,
        bytes memory teamBets
    ) {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);
        gameWinner = address(uint160(_readUint(baseSlot + 8)));
        endTime = _readUint(baseSlot + 13);
        winnerSetFlag = _readUint(baseSlot + 15);
        teamBets = _readBytes(baseSlot + 7);
    }

    function createGame(
        string calldata team1,
        string calldata team2,
        uint256 endTime,
        uint256 threshold,
        string calldata team1Meta,
        address resolverAddr,
        uint256 rewardDuration,
        string calldata team2Meta,
        bytes32[2] calldata hashes,
        bool flag,
        string calldata extraData
    ) external onlyOwner {
        uint256 gameId = _gameCount;
        _gameCount++;

        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);
        _storeString(baseSlot, team1);
        _storeString(baseSlot + 1, team2);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 2, 0);
        _storeString(baseSlot + 3, team1Meta);
        _storeString(baseSlot + 4, team2Meta);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 5, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 6, 0);
        _storeBytes(baseSlot + 7, "");
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 8, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 9, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 10, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 11, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 12, 1);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 13, endTime);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 14, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 15, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 16, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 17, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 18, endTime + rewardDuration);

        emit NewGame(gameId, team1, team2, endTime);
    }

    function bet(uint256 gameId, uint256 teamId) external payable {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);

        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 12) == 0) revert GameNotValid();
        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 13) <= block.timestamp) revert GameNotEndedYet();
        if (teamId > 3) revert NotAValidTeamIdentifier();

        uint256 playerBase = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(baseSlot, msg.sender)));
        uint256 currentBet = _readUint(playerBase);

        if (msg.value == 0 && currentBet == 0) revert NotEnoughBalanceSent();

        _storeUint(playerBase, currentBet + msg.value);
        _storeUint(playerBase + 1, teamId);

        uint256 pool = _readUint(baseSlot + 5) + msg.value;
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 5, pool);
        _totalBetPool += msg.value;

        emit PlayerJoined(gameId, msg.sender, msg.value, teamId);
    }

    function multiBet(
        uint256[] calldata gameIds,
        uint256[] calldata teamIds,
        uint256[] calldata amounts
    ) external payable {
        if (gameIds.length != teamIds.length || gameIds.length != amounts.length) {
            revert LengthsDoNotMatch();
        }

        uint256 totalValue = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < amounts.length; i++) {
            totalValue += amounts[i];
        }

        if (msg.value != totalValue) revert NotEnoughBalanceSent();

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < gameIds.length; i++) {
            uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameIds[i], 0);

            if (_readUint(baseSlot + 12) == 0) revert GameNotValid();
            if (_readUint(baseSlot + 13) <= block.timestamp) revert GameNotEndedYet();
            if (teamIds[i] > 3) revert NotAValidTeamIdentifier();

            uint256 playerBase = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(baseSlot, msg.sender)));
            uint256 currentBet = _readUint(playerBase);

            _storeUint(playerBase, currentBet + amounts[i]);
            _storeUint(playerBase + 1, teamIds[i]);

            uint256 pool = _readUint(baseSlot + 5) + amounts[i];
            _storeUint(baseSlot + 5, pool);

            emit PlayerJoined(gameIds[i], msg.sender, amounts[i], teamIds[i]);
        }

        _totalBetPool += msg.value;
    }

    function remoteSetWinner(uint256 gameId, uint256 teamId, uint256 value) external onlyResolver {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);

        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 13) > block.timestamp) revert GameNotEndedYet();
        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 15) != 0) revert WinnerAlreadySet();

        _storeUint(baseSlot + 15, 1);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 8, uint256(uint160(msg.sender)));

        string memory winningTeam = teamId == 0 ? _readString(baseSlot) : _readString(baseSlot + 1);
        emit WinningTeamSet(gameId, winningTeam);
    }

    function remoteSetWinner(uint256 gameId, string calldata teamName, uint256 value1, uint256 value2) external onlyResolver {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);

        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 13) > block.timestamp) revert GameNotEndedYet();
        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 15) != 0) revert WinnerAlreadySet();

        string memory team1 = _readString(baseSlot);
        string memory team2 = _readString(baseSlot + 1);

        bool isTeam1 = _compareStrings(teamName, team1);
        bool isTeam2 = _compareStrings(teamName, team2);

        if (!isTeam1 && !isTeam2) revert NotAValidTeamNameForGame();

        _storeUint(baseSlot + 15, 1);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 8, uint256(uint160(msg.sender)));

        emit WinningTeamSet(gameId, teamName);
    }

    function callback(uint256 gameId, string calldata teamName) external onlyResolver {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);

        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 13) > block.timestamp) revert GameNotEndedYet();
        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 15) != 0) revert WinnerAlreadySet();

        string memory team1 = _readString(baseSlot);
        string memory team2 = _readString(baseSlot + 1);

        bool isTeam1 = _compareStrings(teamName, team1);
        bool isTeam2 = _compareStrings(teamName, team2);

        if (!isTeam1 && !isTeam2) revert NotAValidTeamNameForGame();

        _storeUint(baseSlot + 15, 1);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 8, uint160(msg.sender));

        emit WinningTeamSet(gameId, teamName);
    }

    function eventSetWinner(uint256 gameId, address winner, uint256 value) external {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);

        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 13) > block.timestamp) revert GameNotEndedYet();
        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 15) != 0) revert WinnerAlreadySet();

        _storeUint(baseSlot + 15, 1);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 8, uint256(uint160(winner)));
    }

    function withdrawReward(uint256 gameId) external {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);

        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 12) == 0) revert GameNotValid();
        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 13) > block.timestamp) revert GameNotEndedYet();
        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 15) == 0) revert WinnerNotSet();

        uint256 playerBase = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(baseSlot, msg.sender)));
        uint256 betAmount = _readUint(playerBase);

        if (betAmount == 0) return;

        uint256 winningTeam = _readUint(baseSlot + 15);
        uint256 playerTeam = _readUint(playerBase + 1);

        uint256 reward = (betAmount * _readUint(baseSlot + 5)) / _readUint(baseSlot + 9);

        if (reward > _readUint(baseSlot + 15)) {
            revert NotEnoughBalanceSent();
        }

        _storeUint(baseSlot + 15, _readUint(baseSlot + 15) - reward);
        _storeUint(playerBase, 0);

        (bool success, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: reward}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");

        emit RewardWithdrawn(gameId, msg.sender, reward);
    }

    function multiWithdrawReward(uint256[] calldata gameIds) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < gameIds.length; i++) {
            this.withdrawReward(gameIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function invalidateGame(uint256 gameId) external onlyOwner {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);

        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 15) != 0) revert WinnerAlreadySet();

        _storeUint(baseSlot + 17, 1);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 13, block.timestamp);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 18, block.timestamp + 604800);

        emit GameInvalidated(gameId);
    }

    function withdrawInvalidated(uint256 gameId) external {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);

        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 12) == 0) revert GameNotInvalidated();

        uint256 playerBase = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(baseSlot, msg.sender)));
        uint256 betAmount = _readUint(playerBase);

        if (betAmount == 0) return;

        _storeUint(playerBase, 0);
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 5, _readUint(baseSlot + 5) - betAmount);

        (bool success, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: betAmount}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
    }

    function withdrawRemainingRewards(uint256 gameId) external onlyOwner {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);

        if (_readUint(baseSlot + 18) > block.timestamp) revert CantWithdrawRemainingRewardsYet();

        uint256 remaining = _readUint(baseSlot + 5);

        _storeUint(baseSlot + 5, 0);

        (bool success, ) = payable(owner).call{value: remaining}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
    }

    function addBalanceToGame(uint256 gameId) external payable onlyOwner {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);
        uint256 pool = _readUint(baseSlot + 5) + msg.value;
        _storeUint(baseSlot + 5, pool);
    }

    function updateGameMeta(uint256 gameId, string calldata team1Meta, string calldata team2Meta) external onlyOwner {
        uint256 baseSlot = _getGameSlot(gameId, 0);
        _storeString(baseSlot + 3, team1Meta);
        _storeString(baseSlot + 4, team2Meta);
    }

    function _readUint(uint256 slot) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 value;
        assembly {
            value := sload(slot)
        }
        return value;
    }

    function _storeUint(uint256 slot, uint256 value) internal {
        assembly {
            sstore(slot, value)
        }
    }

    function _readString(uint256 slot) internal view returns (string memory) {
        uint256 len = _readUint(slot);
        if (len == 0) return "";

        if (len <= 31) {
            uint256 packed = _readUint(slot);
            bytes memory data = new bytes(len);
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                data[i] = bytes1(uint8(packed >> (8 * (31 - i))));
            }
            return string(data);
        }

        uint256 dataSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(slot)));
        uint256 numWords = (len + 31) / 32;
        bytes memory data = new bytes(len);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < numWords; i++) {
            uint256 word = _readUint(dataSlot + i);
            for (uint256 j = 0; j < 32 && i * 32 + j < len; j++) {
                data[i * 32 + j] = bytes1(uint8(word >> (8 * (31 - j))));
            }
        }

        return string(data);
    }

    function _storeString(uint256 slot, string memory str) internal {
        bytes memory data = bytes(str);
        uint256 len = data.length;

        if (len <= 31) {
            uint256 packed;
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                packed |= uint256(uint8(data[i])) << (8 * (31 - i));
            }
            packed |= len;
            _storeUint(slot, packed);
        } else {
            _storeUint(slot, len + 1);
            uint256 dataSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(slot)));
            uint256 numWords = (len + 31) / 32;

            for (uint256 i = 0; i < numWords; i++) {
                uint256 word;
                for (uint256 j = 0; j < 32 && i * 32 + j < len; j++) {
                    word |= uint256(uint8(data[i * 32 + j])) << (8 * (31 - j));
                }
                _storeUint(dataSlot + i, word);
            }
        }
    }

    function _readBytes(uint256 slot) internal view returns (bytes memory) {
        return bytes(_readString(slot));
    }

    function _storeBytes(uint256 slot, bytes memory data) internal {
        _storeString(slot, string(data));
    }

    function _compareStrings(string memory a, string memory b) internal pure returns (bool) {
        return keccak256(bytes(a)) == keccak256(bytes(b));
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.4;

interface IERC721Receiver {
    function onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4);
}

interface IERC165 {
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external view returns (bool);
}

contract NFTMarketplace is IERC165 {
    // Storage layout
    address private _owner;
    uint256 private _feeRate;
    uint256 private _cancelFee;
    uint256 private _pauseFlags; // slot 4: packed bools (paused, feePaused, cancelFeePaused, allAcceptedTokens)
    uint256 private _auctionFlags; // slot 6
    uint256 private _tokenIdCounter; // slot 7
    string private _name; // slot 0x0d
    string private _symbol; // slot 0x0e
    string private _baseURI; // slot 0x0f
    uint256 private _offers; // slot 0x12

    // Mappings (using slot numbers for keccak)
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners; // slot 9
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; // slot 10
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals; // slot 0x0a
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals; // slot 0x0b
    mapping(uint256 => bytes) private _tokenURIs; // slot 0x0c
    mapping(uint256 => Auction) private _auctions; // slot 0x10
    mapping(uint256 => Bid) private _bids; // slot 0x11
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _prices; // slot 0x13
    mapping(uint256 => bool) private _listedMap; // slot 0x14
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _saleTokenAddresses; // slot 0x15
    mapping(address => bool) private _acceptedTokens; // slot 5
    mapping(address => bool) private _tokenDenial; // used for blacklist

    // Enumerable storage
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _ownedTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex;
    uint256[] private _allTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _allTokensIndex;

    struct Auction {
        uint256 price;
        uint256 duration;
        uint256 startTime;
        address owner;
        address tokenAddress;
        bool active;
    }

    struct Bid {
        uint256 amount;
        address bidder;
        bool exists;
    }

    // Events
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed approved, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event Paused(address account);
    event Unpaused(address account);
    event Minted(address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 price, string uri);
    event Purchase(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 tokenId, uint256 price, string uri);
    event PriceUpdate(address indexed owner, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 oldPrice, uint256 newPrice);
    event NftListStatus(address indexed owner, uint256 indexed tokenId, bool isListed);
    event CreateAuction(address indexed owner, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 price, uint256 duration);
    event Bidding(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 amount);
    event CancelBid(uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event CancelAuction(uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event EndAuction(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 amount);
    event SetCancelFee(uint256 fee);
    event FeePaused();
    event FeeUnPaused();
    event CancelFeePaused();
    event CancelFeeUnPaused();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!paused(), "Pausable: paused");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenPaused() {
        require(paused(), "Pausable: not paused");
        _;
    }

    constructor(string memory name_, string memory symbol_) {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        _name = name_;
        _symbol = symbol_;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    // ERC165
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public pure override returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == type(IERC165).interfaceId ||
               interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // ERC721
               interfaceId == 0x780e9d63 || // ERC721Enumerable
               interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f;   // ERC721Metadata
    }

    // ERC721Metadata
    function name() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function baseURI() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseURI;
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721Metadata: URI query for nonexistent token");
        string memory base = _baseURI;
        return string(abi.encodePacked(base, _toString(tokenId)));
    }

    // ERC721
    function balanceOf(address owner_) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for zero address");
        return _balances[owner_];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
        return owner_;
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(to != owner_, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(msg.sender == owner_ || isApprovedForAll(owner_, msg.sender),
            "ERC721: approve caller is not owner nor approved for all");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(owner_, to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: approved query for nonexistent token");
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner_, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner_][operator];
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    // ERC721Enumerable
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner_, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for zero address");
        require(index < _balances[owner_], "EnumerableSet: index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[owner_][index];
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _allTokens.length, "EnumerableMap: index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    // Ownable
    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        require(!paused(), "Pausable: paused");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    // Pausable
    function pause() external onlyOwner {
        _setPaused(true);
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function unpause() external onlyOwner {
        _setPaused(false);
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    function paused() public view returns (bool) {
        return (_pauseFlags & 1) == 1;
    }

    // Fee management
    function feeRate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _feeRate;
    }

    function setFee(uint256 fee) external onlyOwner {
        require(fee <= 100, "Fee too high");
        _feeRate = fee;
    }

    function feePaused() external view returns (bool) {
        return (_pauseFlags & 2) == 2;
    }

    function feePause() external onlyOwner {
        _pauseFlags |= 2;
        emit FeePaused();
    }

    function feeUnPause() external onlyOwner {
        require(!paused(), "Pausable: paused");
        _pauseFlags &= ~uint256(2);
        emit FeeUnPaused();
    }

    // Cancel fee management
    function cancelFeeRate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _cancelFee;
    }

    function setCancelFee(uint256 fee) external onlyOwner {
        require(fee <= 100, "Fee too high");
        _cancelFee = fee;
        emit SetCancelFee(fee);
    }

    function cancelFeePaused() external view returns (bool) {
        return (_pauseFlags & 4) == 4;
    }

    function cancelFeePause() external onlyOwner {
        _pauseFlags |= 4;
        emit CancelFeePaused();
    }

    function cancelFeeUnPause() external onlyOwner {
        _pauseFlags &= ~uint256(4);
        emit CancelFeeUnPaused();
    }

    // Accepted tokens
    function allAcceptedTokens() external view returns (bool) {
        return (_pauseFlags & 0x100) != 0;
    }

    function setAllAcceptedTokens(bool status) external onlyOwner {
        if (status) {
            _pauseFlags |= 0x100;
        } else {
            _pauseFlags &= ~uint256(0x100);
        }
    }

    function acceptedTokens(address token) external view returns (bool) {
        return _acceptedTokens[token];
    }

    function tokenAccepted(address token) external view returns (bool) {
        return _acceptedTokens[token];
    }

    function tokenDenial(address token) external view returns (bool) {
        return _tokenDenial[token];
    }

    // Minting
    function mint(address to, string memory uri, address tokenAddress, uint256 price) external onlyOwner {
        uint256 tokenId = _tokenIdCounter;
        _tokenIdCounter++;
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        _prices[tokenId] = price;
        _saleTokenAddresses[tokenId] = tokenAddress;
        emit Minted(to, tokenId, price, uri);
    }

    function auctionMint(address to, string memory uri, address tokenAddress, uint256 price, uint256 duration) external onlyOwner {
        uint256 tokenId = _tokenIdCounter;
        _tokenIdCounter++;
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        _createAuction(tokenAddress, tokenId, price, duration);
        emit Minted(to, tokenId, price, uri);
    }

    function burn(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: burn caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burn(tokenId);
    }

    // Marketplace
    function price(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _prices[tokenId];
    }

    function listedMap(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _listedMap[tokenId];
    }

    function saleTokenAddresses(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        return _saleTokenAddresses[tokenId];
    }

    function updatePrice(uint256 tokenId, uint256 newPrice) external {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ == msg.sender, "ERC721: caller is not owner");
        uint256 oldPrice = _prices[tokenId];
        _prices[tokenId] = newPrice;
        emit PriceUpdate(msg.sender, tokenId, oldPrice, newPrice);
    }

    function updateListingStatus(uint256 tokenId, bool isListed) external {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ == msg.sender, "ERC721: caller is not owner");
        _listedMap[tokenId] = isListed;
        emit NftListStatus(msg.sender, tokenId, isListed);
    }

    function updateSale(address tokenAddress, uint256 tokenId, uint256 price_) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _saleTokenAddresses[tokenId] = tokenAddress;
        _prices[tokenId] = price_;
    }

    function buy(uint256 tokenId) external payable whenNotPaused {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: operator query for nonexistent token");
        require(_listedMap[tokenId], "Token not listed");
        require(!_hasAuction[tokenId] || (_auctionFlags & 1) == 0, "Auction active");
        
        uint256 tokenPrice = _prices[tokenId];
        require(msg.value >= tokenPrice, "Insufficient payment");
        
        address tokenAddress = _saleTokenAddresses[tokenId];
        uint256 feeAmount = (tokenPrice * _feeRate) / 100;
        
        _transfer(owner_, msg.sender, tokenId);
        _listedMap[tokenId] = false;
        
        if (tokenAddress == address(0)) {
            payable(owner_).transfer(tokenPrice - feeAmount);
        }
        
        emit Purchase(owner_, msg.sender, tokenId, tokenPrice, "");
    }

    // Auction functions
    function hasAuction(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _hasAuction[tokenId];
    }

    function bids(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256 amount, address bidder, bool exists) {
        Bid storage bid_ = _bids[tokenId];
        return (bid_.amount, bid_.bidder, bid_.exists);
    }

    function offers(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _offers;
    }

    function createAuction(address tokenAddress, uint256 tokenId, uint256 price_, uint256 duration) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _createAuction(tokenAddress, tokenId, price_, duration);
    }

    function _createAuction(address tokenAddress, uint256 tokenId, uint256 price_, uint256 duration) internal {
        require(duration >= 60, "Duration too short");
        _hasAuction[tokenId] = true;
        _auctions[tokenId] = Auction({
            price: price_,
            duration: duration,
            startTime: block.timestamp,
            owner: msg.sender,
            tokenAddress: tokenAddress,
            active: true
        });
        emit CreateAuction(msg.sender, tokenId, price_, duration);
    }

    function bid(uint256 tokenId, uint256 amount_) external payable whenNotPaused {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction for token");
        Auction storage auction = _auctions[tokenId];
        require(auction.active, "Auction not active");
        require(block.timestamp < auction.startTime + auction.duration, "Auction ended");
        require(amount_ > auction.price, "Bid too low");
        
        if (_bids[tokenId].exists) {
            payable(_bids[tokenId].bidder).transfer(_bids[tokenId].amount);
        }
        
        _bids[tokenId] = Bid({
            amount: amount_,
            bidder: msg.sender,
            exists: true
        });
        auction.price = amount_;
        
        emit Bidding(tokenId, amount_);
    }

    function cancelBid(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_bids[tokenId].bidder == msg.sender, "Not bidder");
        uint256 amount_ = _bids[tokenId].amount;
        _bids[tokenId] = Bid({amount: 0, bidder: address(0), exists: false});
        payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount_);
        emit CancelBid(tokenId);
    }

    function cancelAuction(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction for token");
        Auction storage auction = _auctions[tokenId];
        require(auction.owner == msg.sender || _owner == msg.sender, "Not auction owner");
        require(auction.active, "Auction not active");
        
        auction.active = false;
        _hasAuction[tokenId] = false;
        
        if (_bids[tokenId].exists) {
            payable(_bids[tokenId].bidder).transfer(_bids[tokenId].amount);
            _bids[tokenId] = Bid({amount: 0, bidder: address(0), exists: false});
        }
        
        emit CancelAuction(tokenId);
    }

    function endAuction(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction for token");
        Auction storage auction = _auctions[tokenId];
        require(block.timestamp >= auction.startTime + auction.duration, "Auction not ended");
        
        uint256 amount_ = auction.price;
        address winner = _bids[tokenId].bidder;
        
        if (winner != address(0)) {
            _transfer(auction.owner, winner, tokenId);
            uint256 feeAmount = (amount_ * _feeRate) / 100;
            payable(auction.owner).transfer(amount_ - feeAmount);
        }
        
        auction.active = false;
        _hasAuction[tokenId] = false;
        _bids[tokenId] = Bid({amount: 0, bidder: address(0), exists: false});
        
        emit EndAuction(tokenId, amount_);
    }

    // Admin
    function setBaseURI(string memory baseURI_) external onlyOwner {
        _baseURI = baseURI_;
    }

    function _contractOwner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    // Internal functions
    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: operator query for nonexistent token");
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        return (spender == owner_ || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender || isApprovedForAll(owner_, spender));
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(_owners[tokenId] == from, "ERC721: transfer of token that is not own");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to zero address");
        
        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
        
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        emit Approval(from, address(0), tokenId);
        
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721 implementer");
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");
        
        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
        
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _burn(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        
        _beforeTokenTransfer(owner_, address(0), tokenId);
        
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        emit Approval(owner_, address(0), tokenId);
        
        _balances[owner_] -= 1;
        delete _owners[tokenId];
        
        emit Transfer(owner_, address(0), tokenId);
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        }
        if (to == address(0)) {
            _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (to != from) {
            _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 length = _balances[to];
        _ownedTokens[to][length] = tokenId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length;
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _balances[from] - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        
        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }
        
        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
    }

    function _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        uint256 lastTokenId = _allTokens[lastTokenIndex];
        
        _allTokens[tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
        _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        
        delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        _allTokens.pop();
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
                return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
            } catch (bytes memory reason) {
                if (reason.length == 0) {
                    revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721 implementer");
                } else {
                    assembly {
                        revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    function _setPaused(bool status) internal {
        if (status) {
            _pauseFlags |= 1;
        } else {
            _pauseFlags &= ~uint256(1);
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

contract Ownable {
    address private _owner;

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), _owner);
    }

    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {

        _owner = newOwner;

}

        _isExcludedFromFee[address(this)] = true;

        require(recipient != address(0), "BEP20: transfer to the zero address");
        require(amount > 0, "Transfer amount must be greater than zero");
        require(!_isBlacklisted[sender] && !_isBlacklisted[recipient], "Blacklisted address");

        if (sender != owner() && recipient != owner()) {
            require(tradingActive, "Trading is not active yet.");
        }

        if (!_excludedFromTransactionlock[sender] && !_excludedFromTransactionlock[recipient]) {

            require(balanceOf(recipient) + amount <= _maxTokensPerAddress, "Exceeds max tokens per address.");

 * @title ContractsRegistry
 * @dev Registry contract for managing named contracts with proxy support and dependency injection

contract ContractsRegistry {
    // Storage slots
    // slot 0: packed (initialized flag, admin setup flag)
    // slot 0x65: registry admin address
    // mapping at 0x66: contract addresses by name
    // mapping at 0x67: isProxy flag by name
    // mapping at 0x33: counter/index by name
    // mapping at 0x02 + hash: implementation addresses

    bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00;
    bytes32 public constant REGISTRY_ADMIN_ROLE = 0xbf584c4b8a33b9e1b5b8b7e8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e;

    // Role management storage
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => bool)) private _roles;
    mapping(bytes32 => address[]) private _roleMembers;
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _roleMemberIndex;
    mapping(bytes32 => bytes32) private _roleAdmins;

    // Contract registry storage
    mapping(bytes32 => address) private _contracts;
    mapping(bytes32 => bool) private _isProxy;
    mapping(bytes32 => address) private _implementations;

    address private _admin;
    bool private _initialized;

    // Events
    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleAdminChanged(bytes32 indexed role, bytes32 indexed previousAdminRole, bytes32 indexed newAdminRole);
    event AdminChanged(address previousAdmin, address newAdmin);
    event Upgraded(address indexed implementation);

    // Modifiers
    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(hasRole(REGISTRY_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "ContractsRegistry: Caller is not an admin");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyInitialized() {
        require(_initialized, "Initializable: contract is not initialized");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyNotInitialized() {
        require(!_initialized, "Initializable: contract is already initialized");
        _;
    }

    // Initialize function
    function __ContractsRegistry_init() external onlyNotInitialized {
        _initialized = true;
        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(REGISTRY_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _setRoleAdmin(REGISTRY_ADMIN_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
    }

    // Role management functions
    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role][account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _roleAdmins[role];
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        require(hasRole(getRoleAdmin(role), msg.sender), "AccessControl: sender must be an admin to grant");
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        require(hasRole(getRoleAdmin(role), msg.sender), "AccessControl: sender must be an admin to revoke");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role][account] = true;
            _roleMemberIndex[role][account] = _roleMembers[role].length;
            _roleMembers[role].push(account);
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role][account] = false;
            uint256 index = _roleMemberIndex[role][account];
            address[] storage members = _roleMembers[role];
            if (index < members.length - 1) {
                address lastMember = members[members.length - 1];
                members[index] = lastMember;
                _roleMemberIndex[role][lastMember] = index;
            }
            members.pop();
            delete _roleMemberIndex[role][account];
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) internal {
        bytes32 previousAdminRole = getRoleAdmin(role);
        _roleAdmins[role] = adminRole;
        emit RoleAdminChanged(role, previousAdminRole, adminRole);
    }

    function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) public view returns (address) {
        require(index < _roleMembers[role].length, "EnumerableSet: index out of bounds");
        return _roleMembers[role][index];
    }

    function getRoleMemberCount(bytes32 role) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _roleMembers[role].length;
    }

    // Contract registry functions
    function addContract(bytes32 name, address contractAddr) external onlyAdmin {
        require(contractAddr != address(0), "ContractsRegistry: Null address is not a contract");
        _contracts[name] = contractAddr;
        _isProxy[name] = false;
    }

    function addProxyContract(bytes32 name, address implementation) external onlyAdmin returns (address) {
        require(implementation != address(0), "ContractsRegistry: Null address is not a contract");
        address proxy = _deployProxy(implementation);
        _contracts[name] = proxy;
        _implementations[name] = implementation;
        _isProxy[name] = true;
        return proxy;
    }

    function justAddProxyContract(bytes32 name, address proxyAddr) external onlyAdmin {
        require(proxyAddr != address(0), "ContractsRegistry: Null address is not a contract");
        _contracts[name] = proxyAddr;
        _isProxy[name] = true;
    }

    function upgradeContract(bytes32 name, address newImplementation) external onlyAdmin {
        require(_contracts[name] != address(0), "CR._upgradeContract: This mapping doesn't exist");
        require(_isProxy[name], "ContractsRegistry: Not a proxy contract");
        _upgradeProxy(_contracts[name], newImplementation);
        _implementations[name] = newImplementation;
    }

    function upgradeContractAndCall(bytes32 name, address newImplementation, string calldata initData) external onlyAdmin {
        require(_contracts[name] != address(0), "CR._upgradeContract: This mapping doesn't exist");
        require(_isProxy[name], "ContractsRegistry: Not a proxy contract");
        _upgradeProxyAndCall(_contracts[name], newImplementation, initData);
        _implementations[name] = newImplementation;
    }

    function deleteContract(bytes32 name) external onlyAdmin {
        require(_contracts[name] != address(0), "CR.deleteContract: This mapping doesn't exist");
        delete _contracts[name];
        delete _isProxy[name];
        delete _implementations[name];
    }

    function getContract(bytes32 name) public view returns (address) {
        require(_contracts[name] != address(0), "CR.getContract: This mapping doesn't exist");
        return _contracts[name];
    }

    function getImplementation(bytes32 name) public view returns (address) {
        require(_contracts[name] != address(0), "CR.getImplementation: This mapping doesn't exist");
        require(_isProxy[name], "ContractsRegistry: Not a proxy contract");
        return _implementations[name];
    }

    function hasContract(bytes32 name) public view returns (bool) {
        return _contracts[name] != address(0);
    }

    function injectDependencies(bytes32 name) external onlyAdmin {
        require(_contracts[name] != address(0), "CR.injectDependencies: This mapping doesn't exist");
        address contractAddr = _contracts[name];
        (bool success,) = contractAddr.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("setDependencies(address)", address(this)));

    bytes32 public constant APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION_TYPEHASH = 0x10c8b404d8c1c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3;
    bytes32 public constant INCREASE_APPROVAL_WITH_AUTHORIZATION_TYPEHASH = 0x97ecb37fd8c1c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3;
    bytes32 public constant DECREASE_APPROVAL_WITH_AUTHORIZATION_TYPEHASH = 0x6bb5d5afd8c1c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3;
    bytes32 public constant CANCEL_AUTHORIZATION_TYPEHASH = 0xd9169487d8c1c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3d8c3;
    
    string public constant VERSION = "2";
    
    // Events
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event AdministratorAdded(address indexed account);
    event AdministratorRemoved(address indexed account);
    event SupplierAdded(address indexed account);
    event SupplierRemoved(address indexed account);
    event SeizerAdded(address indexed account);
    event SeizerRemoved(address indexed account);
    event RealmAdministratorAdded(address indexed account);
    event RealmAdministratorRemoved(address indexed account);
    event ProcessorChanged(address indexed processor);
    event RealmChanged(address indexed realm);
    event PriceOracleChanged(address indexed priceOracle);
    event TrustedIntermediariesChanged(address[] intermediaries);
    event RulesChanged(uint256[] rules, uint256[] values);
    event Mint(address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event Burn(address indexed from, uint256 amount);
    event Seize(address indexed from, uint256 amount);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event AuthorizationUsed(address indexed authorizer, bytes32 indexed nonce);
    event AuthorizationCanceled(address indexed authorizer, bytes32 indexed nonce);
    
    // Modifiers
    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }
    
    modifier onlyProcessor() {
        require(_processor == msg.sender, "P0");
        _;
    }
    
    modifier onlyAdministrator() {
        require(_administrators[msg.sender], "AD0");
        _;
    }
    
    modifier onlySupplier() {
        require(_suppliers[msg.sender], "SI0");
        _;
    }
    
    modifier onlySeizer() {
        require(_seizers[msg.sender], "SE0");
        _;
    }
    
    modifier onlyRealmAdministrator() {
        require(_realmAdministrators[msg.sender], "RA0");
        _;
    }
    
    modifier notPaused() {
        require(_initialized == 2, "PO3");
        _;
    }
    
    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }
    
    // ERC20 functions
    function name() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }
    
    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    }

        return true;

        return true;

        _transfer(from, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

        if (subtractedValue >= oldValue) {

        return true;

        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from zero address");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to zero address");
        require(_balances[from] >= amount, "ERC20: insufficient balance");
        
        _balances[from] -= amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }
    
    function _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC20: approve from zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to zero address");
        
        _allowances[owner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }
    
    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: mint to zero address");
        
        _totalSupply += amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
        emit Mint(to, amount);
    }
    
    function _burn(address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: burn from zero address");
        require(_balances[from] >= amount, "ERC20: burn amount exceeds balance");
        
        _balances[from] -= amount;
        _totalSupply -= amount;
        emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
        emit Burn(from, amount);
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlySupplier {
        _mint(to, amount);
    }
    
    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external onlySupplier {
        _burn(from, amount);
    }
    
    function burn(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external onlySupplier {
        _burn(from, amount);
    }
    
    function seize(address from, uint256 amount) external onlySeizer {
        _balances[from] -= amount;
        _totalSupply -= amount;
        emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
        emit Seize(from, amount);
    }
    
    function seize(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external onlySeizer {
        _balances[from] -= amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
        emit Seize(from, amount);
    }

    function addAdministrator(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(!_administrators[account], "Roles: account already has role");
        _administrators[account] = true;
        emit AdministratorAdded(account);
    }
    
    function removeAdministrator(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(_administrators[account], "Roles: account does not have role");
        _administrators[account] = false;
        emit AdministratorRemoved(account);
    }

        return _administrators[account];
    }
    
    function addSupplier(address account) external onlyAdministrator {
        require(!_suppliers[account], "Roles: account already has role");
        _suppliers[account] = true;
        emit SupplierAdded(account);
    }
    
    function removeSupplier(address account) external onlyAdministrator {
        require(_suppliers[account], "Roles: account does not have role");
        _suppliers[account] = false;
        emit SupplierRemoved(account);
    }
    
    function isSupplier(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _suppliers[account];
    }
    
    function addSeizer(address account) external onlyAdministrator {
        require(!_seizers[account], "Roles: account already has role");
        _seizers[account] = true;
        emit SeizerAdded(account);
    }
    
    function removeSeizer(address account) external onlyAdministrator {

        _seizers[account] = false;
        emit SeizerRemoved(account);
    }

        return _seizers[account];
    }

        require(!_realmAdministrators[account], "Roles: account already has role");
        _realmAdministrators[account] = true;
        emit RealmAdministratorAdded(account);
    }
    
    function removeRealmAdministrator(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(_realmAdministrators[account], "Roles: account does not have role");
        _realmAdministrators[account] = false;
        emit RealmAdministratorRemoved(account);
    }

    }

        return _owner;
    }

        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "BT0");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            _transfer(msg.sender, recipients[i], amounts[i]);
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    function bulkTransferFrom(address from, address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) external returns (bool) {
        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "BT0");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            _approve(from, msg.sender, _allowances[from][msg.sender] - amounts[i]);

        }
        return true;

        require(msg.sender == authorizer, "CA0");

        require(signer == from, "SI0");

            _DOMAIN_SEPARATOR,
            keccak256(abi.encode(

        address signer = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
        require(signer == from, "SI0");
        
        _authorizationStates[from][nonce] = true;
        emit AuthorizationUsed(from, nonce);
        
        uint256 oldValue = _allowances[from][spender];
        if (subtractedValue >= oldValue) {

        } else {
